title: Live Honoring God and Humankind (Ko Khun To Im Tip-Briew Tip-Blei)
khasi_title: Ko Khun To Im Tip-Briew Tip-Blei
cultural_context: The cardinal ethical imperative of Khasi philosophy: 'Tip-Briew Tip-Blei' (to know humankind is to know God), rendered into a father's poetic blessing, from 'Ki Sur Ba Dang Sawa'.

khasi: Ko khun, to im tip-briew tip-Blei,
Ha man ka lynti ba me iaid;
Wat klet ia ka kamai ia ka hok,
Wat tuh, wat lute ia ka spah kiwei;
U Blei Uba Khraw U peit na bneng,
U iohi ia man ka jingpyrkhat;
Uba bat ia ka hok u ioh jingsuk,
Uba iaid lamwir un shem jynjar.
english: O my child, live honoring humankind and revering God,
In every pathway where your footsteps tread;
Never forget to earn your livelihood through righteousness,
Never steal, never seize another's property;
Almighty God gazes down from high heaven,
Observing every secret thought of the heart;
He who clings unto righteousness shall find peace,
He who walks in deceit shall reap despair.

khasi: Burom ia la ka kmie bad ia la u kpa,
Khein kor ia ki kñi bad ki bakha;
Ka akor babha dei ka ksiar ba kor,
Ba pynphyrnai ia ka jingim baroh;
Lada me ri ia kane ka kyntien,
Me long u khun ba donbok donkupar,
Bad ka nam jong me kan tyngshain
Ha la ka shnong bad ha la ka ri.
english: Honor your mother and honor your father,
Treat with sacred esteem your maternal uncles and paternal kin;
Good etiquette and noble character are true gold,
Illuminating the whole course of human life;
If you safeguard this ancestral counsel,
You shall be a blessed and fortunate soul,
And your honorable name shall radiate
Throughout your village and your native land.

vocabulary.kamai ia ka hok: earning righteousness / lawful livelihood (primary Khasi life goal)
vocabulary.kñi: maternal uncle / clan elder and counselor
vocabulary.bakha: paternal cousins / kin on father's side
vocabulary.donbok donkupar: blessed with fortune, grace, and divine favor
